name: Ministry of Finance
role: Subsidies, transfers to states and tax collection. Raises tax compliance and public services.

name: Ministry of Home Affairs
role: Police and internal order. Improves public services; drives law and order from Phase 3.

name: Ministry of Defence
role: Armed forces pay, upkeep and procurement. Drives military strength from Phase 4.

name: Ministry of External Affairs
role: Diplomacy and trade promotion. Improves customs revenue; drives relations from Phase 5.

name: Ministry of Health
role: Hospitals and public health. Raises living standards (HDI) and public services.

name: Ministry of Education
role: Schools and universities. Raises HDI and long-term services and tech growth.

name: Ministry of Agriculture
role: Farm support, irrigation and food supply. Grows agriculture, eases food prices and rural jobs.

name: Ministry of Industry & Infrastructure
role: Roads, rail, power and industrial policy. Grows industry, energy and services and creates jobs.

name: National Disaster Management Authority
role: Disaster preparedness and relief. Improves public services; handles emergencies from Phase 3.

name: Directorate of Intelligence
role: Domestic and foreign intelligence. Counters terror and espionage from Phase 3.

name: Anti-Corruption Bureau
role: Investigations and audits. Lowers national corruption and exposes corrupt ministers.
